mainEntity.name: How long is recovery after liposuction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Recovery depends on the areas treated. Most patients wear compression garments for several weeks and return to activity gradually, as their surgeon advises.

mainEntity.name: Will the fat come back after liposuction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Removed fat cells don't regrow, but the remaining fat cells can enlarge with weight gain. Keeping a stable weight helps maintain your results.
